AlertMatch.description:
AlertMatch carries a fired alert rule's match details, shared by every
 delivery-channel RPC in this service so the two channel-specific request
 messages can't drift on field number or shape.

firedAt.description: Fire timestamp, Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

ruleId.description: The alert rule's id (for logging/traceability only).

score.description: Match score at fire time (0-100; see alert-rules.ts's scoring formula).

severity.description: Rule severity at fire time. "all" means no minimum was configured.

DeliverAlertEmailRequest.description:
DeliverAlertEmailRequest carries a fired alert rule's match details plus the
 destination email address the user configured on that rule.

email.description: Destination email address, as configured on the rule.

DeliverAlertEmailResponse.description: DeliverAlertEmailResponse reports whether the email was sent.

delivered.description: True if the email provider accepted the send.

DeliverAlertWebhookRequest.description:
DeliverAlertWebhookRequest carries a fired alert rule's match details plus the
 destination webhook URL the user configured on that rule. Gated to the
 webhook-alerts (analyst+) tier server-side.

webhookUrl.description:
Destination webhook URL, as configured on the rule. Must be http(s),
 validated + SSRF-checked server-side before any request is made.

DeliverAlertWebhookResponse.description: DeliverAlertWebhookResponse reports whether the webhook POST succeeded.

delivered.description: True if the destination responded with a 2xx status.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

post.description: DeliverAlertEmail sends a fired alert rule's match to an email address.

DeliverAlertWebhook POSTs a fired alert rule's match to a webhook URL.
 Gated to the webhook-alerts (analyst+) tier.
